svg.text: Phase 2 · step 2i · Settings: your preferences and the household defaults (decision #029): two options
Display only: stored values never change. Each person can follow the household default or choose their own; an Admin sets the defaults in Admin mode. The theme stays per device.
A · One page of sections; each of your settings is a menu whose first choice is "Household default (…)"
Wide · Admin mode (Household defaults shows only in Admin mode)
Follow the household default, or choose your own.
For everyone who hasn't chosen their own.
Example: Stuart chose Kilometers; everything else follows the household.
Changes save at once (no Save button); each setting is its own record (#029).
− Long menus for currency and language.
B · Two tabs (You | Household); each setting is a row of buttons, with a "Use household default" switch
Currency and language: a searchable list (too many for buttons). Theme sits below, under This device.
+ One tap to choose; the choices are visible.
− Rows of buttons crowd on phones.
